title: Prospective analysis of treatment after surgical management of ankle injuries
summary:
Ankle injuries are common and are often treated surgically. Previous follow-up treatment has generally involved complete immobilisation and no weight-bearing or partial weight-bearing. Other studies have already shown that early movement and weight-bearing can be beneficial for recovery.
The aim of this study is therefore to directly compare early movement and weight-bearing after surgery with the previous standard follow-up treatment.
conditions: Fracture of lower leg, including ankle
Dislocation, sprain and strain of joints and ligaments at ankle and foot level

interventions.name: Early functional follow-up treatment with immediate post-operative pain-adapted free movement and pain-adapted full weight-bearing
Control group with standard follow-up treatment

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with ankle injuries who undergo surgery at our clinic
Exclusion criteria:
Persons incapable of giving consent,
minor patients,
pregnancy
